title: Independently test record-link import mapping completeness
outcome: Independently test record-link import mapping completeness
acceptance: A runtime schema inventory independently checks applicable record-link columns against explicit RENAMED_COLUMNS destinations or justified unchanged/derived exclusions.
Canonical bytes and ids remain unchanged; ambiguous names and unknown/missing columns still refuse; required gates and paired review pass.
The import regression asserts the exact exercised mapping count instead of only a nonzero floor and fails when an applicable mapping is omitted.

completion.summary: Added independent migration-mapping coverage that derives the current record-link inventory, proves every applicable legacy column has exactly one explicit mapping, verifies copied and populated mappings are exercised, and requires exact rebuilt-projection exclusion reasons. Combined gates and paired review passed.
